BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO


SECTION 1: Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance is
hereby amended by changing all the Bl-1 Neighborhood Shopping District symbols and
indications as shown on Map No. 11 -H in the area bounded by


West Lawrence Avenue; North Oakley Avenue; the public alley next south of and parallel to
West Lawrence Avenue; the public alley next west of North Oakley Avenue; a linc 60 feet south
of and parallel to West Lawrence Avenue; a line 67 feet west of and parallel to North Oakley
Avenue


to the designation of Cl-1 Neighborhood Commercial District, as amended and a corresponding
use district is hereby established in the area above described.


SECTION 2: This Ordinance shall be in force and effect from after its passage and due
publication.
